In the AdviceBootstrap Javadoc classloader diagram, restore the vertical column alignment lost when IndyBootstrapDispatcher became AdviceBootstrapDispatcher. The up-arrow after the dispatcher should align with the agent-classloader vertical line in the surrounding rows, as it did before the rename. In instrumentation/internal/internal-reflection/javaagent/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/internal/reflection/ClassInstrumentation.java, replace the remaining 'via indy bootstrap method' wording with a precise advice-bootstrap/invokedynamic explanation, and rename the isIndy field, constructor parameter, and corresponding uses to useIsolatedAdvice. This branch identifies the isolated-advice transformer, not independently selected helper placement. Preserve the existing instanceof IndyTypeTransformerImpl predicate on this PR; the TypeTransformerImpl rename/package move belongs to another PR and must not be copied here.

Keep all packages, bootstrap method names/signatures, callsite descriptors/arguments, and runtime behavior unchanged. Do not modify other PRs, change the base, or create another PR. Run the narrowest applicable spotlessApply directly, followed by targeted bootstrap and internal-reflection compilation/tests.
